# DERMATOLOGIC SURGICAL SITE INFECTIONS

If an infection develops, obtain a gram stain and/or culture. Suture removal,

incision and drainage is recommended. Antimicrobials may be beneficial in

surgical site infections with significant systemic response (i.e induration

greater than 5cm from wound edge, fever, tachycardia and leukocytosis).

In general, most post-op infections develop greater than 48 hours after surgery.

Start on antibiotics as below until culture result is available and then switch

antibiotics, if indicated.

Treat for 5-7 days

# Operations involving trunk or extremity away from axilla or perineum

[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h \($\) R](psozid-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid)

Penicillin allergy or MRSA risk factors

[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet BID \($\) R,DI](psozid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

Severe infections or unable to take oral medications

[Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h \($\) R](psjizid-cefazolin-2gm-ivpb-q8h)

Penicillin allergy or MRSA risk factors and severe infection or unable to take

oral medications

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)

# Operations involving the axilla, gastrointestinal tract, or perineum, or female

# genital tract

[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h \($\) R <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q8h \($\) DI](orz-set-abx-op-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-q12h-metron-500mg-po-q8h)

Penicillin allergy

[Ciprofloxacin 50O mg PO q12h \($\) R,DI <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q8h \($](orz-set-abx-op-ciprof-500mg-po-bid-metro-500mg-po-tid)

[DI]

MRSA risk factors

[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet BID \($\) R,DI <AND> metronidazole](orz-set-abx-op-tmp-1-ds-tab-po-bid-metro-500mg-po-tid)

500 mg PO TID ($) [DI]

Severe infections or unable to take oral medications

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h \($\) M <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h \($\) DI](orz-set-abx-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h-metron-500mg-iv-q8h)

Penicillin allergy and severe infections or unable to take oral medications

[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h \($\) R,DI <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h \($](orz-set-abx-ciprof-400mg-iv-q12-metron-500mg-iv-q8h)

[DI]

MRSA risk factors and severe infections or unable to take oral medications

< ADD > to one of the above IV regimens for operations involving axilla or

perineum

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)
